transcript.text: Thanks everyone for being here. As part of the routine review before we finalize an interim account plan for Northstar, I need to hear from Casey and Ravi specifically. Please each state any scheduling constraints or directly observed relationship conditions that the plan should accommodate. This will help me set a workable temporary assignment and process, especially given that the client-contact plan is due for review before next week's client status call.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to disclose something important. I've personally observed three heated handoff incidents between Casey and Morgan in the past month. Additionally, Morgan has asked not to meet one-to-one with Casey until a facilitated repair occurs. I have incident notes documented but haven't submitted them to Elena yet. I'm sharing this now so the interim plan can account for this relationship condition.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a scheduling constraint I need to put on the table. I have a fixed caregiving pickup at 15:45, so I can commit to one recurring coordination meeting from 15:00 to 15:30, but I cannot reliably attend a later meeting or more than two live coordination meetings per week. I hadn't raised this yet because the revised arrangement hadn't been discussed until now.
transcript.speaker: A3

decisions.casey_assignment: Casey continues as direct client liaison for Northstar, with handoffs routed through a structured template and no direct one-to-one handoffs with Morgan until facilitated repair occurs.
decisions.casey_direct_contact_mode: Casey maintains direct client contact; internal handoffs with Morgan are routed through structured written templates and/or a third-party intermediary rather than direct one-to-one exchanges.

commitments.detail: Ravi to submit documented incident notes regarding the three heated handoff incidents between Casey and Morgan to Elena for the record.
Elena to arrange a facilitated repair session between Casey and Morgan before resuming direct one-to-one handoffs.
Elena to establish a standardized handoff template for Northstar to replace the current inconsistent email and chat practices.
Morgan to be informed of the interim plan and asked to attend the weekly coordination meeting going forward, as non-attendance has been noted.
Interim plan to be reviewed and finalized before next week's Northstar client status call.
